kitDescription: Guilty: Mighty Bunny is a Water sniper-rifle Attacker whose kit revolves around a two-state 'Bunny Mode' she can switch between by holding a full charge for a second: Stance or Engage. In Stance she gets a steady damage boost (+20.45% attack damage, +40% charge damage) and every fully charged shot adds a bonus hit worth 450.89% of her ATK. In Engage her shots instead become true damage (which benefits from any 'True Damage up' support) and each full charge adds a 370.08% true-damage bonus hit. She also has a permanent +20.1% ATK from battle start, and entering a mode drags any allies with their own Bunny Mode into the same state. Her burst swaps her weapon for one 'Mighty Stomp' shot — a fixed 1.5-second charge hitting for 101.3% at 250% full-charge damage, supercharged by a one-round +1400% charge-damage buff — and gives her +77.35% attack damage for 10 seconds.

skill1.driverSaid: battleStart → self buff atkPct 20.1, no expiry (G1: one grant at frame 0, expiresFrame null)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 encoded trigger 'passive' instead of 'battleStart' — uptime-identical for a continuous no-duration self buff; S5 asserted the same event shape and it passes
skill1.formulaCheck: plain ATK ▲ % dilutes into the (1+ΣATK%)·staticAtk sum per §1a — atkPct is the right stat, not casterAtkPct or attackDamagePct
skill1.explanation: Exact value, self-only, continuous; S5's zeroing counterfactual confirms load-bearing and teammate-inert. The passive-vs-battleStart diff is cosmetic (RECON-level), not a divergence.

skill1.kitLine: Full Charge maintained 1+ sec → new Mode
skill1.driverSaid: static modes ['Stance','Engage'], Stance default (battle-start branch fires the not-in-Stance arm); toggle unmodeled — caveat with the rapunzel-pure-grace precedent (sim releases at full charge, never holds)
skill1.blindSaid: both S2b reviewers AND the S6 blind independently converged on exactly this encoding: static mode gate, Stance first/default, toggle ⚑-flagged with the ≥1s hold cost uncharged
skill1.formulaCheck: no engine primitive toggles a self mode on a sustained-charge condition; a bare fullCharge trigger would flip every pull (wrong twice over, per S2b #1)
skill1.explanation: Three independent derivations agree the static-mode gate is the only expressible encoding and that Stance is the t=0 state. The uncharged ~1s opening hold for an Engage selection and mid-fight alternation are the documented residue.

skill1.kitLine: enters Engage → allies in Stance follow
skill1.driverSaid: unmodeled, verbatim in unmodeled.skill1 + a caveat naming sin-swift-bunny as the only would-be consumer ('select the same mode for both')
skill1.blindSaid: both S2b reviewers marked UNMODELED (inert in controlComp — no second Bunny-Mode carrier); S5's leak test asserts none of her self-only magnitudes land on a teammate, and it passes
skill1.formulaCheck: the line writes a mode on OTHER bunny-mode units, carries no stat payload, and has no consumer at scope
skill1.explanation: Correctly recorded, not dropped; behaviorally inert on the graded comp and proven leak-free by the blind test.

skill1.kitLine: enters Stance → allies in Engage follow
skill1.blindSaid: mirror of the sibling line, same UNMODELED ruling from all blind roles
skill1.explanation: Same disposition as its mirror; covered by the same passing no-leak assertion.

skill2.explanation: Mode-scoped flavor tag, proven live in Engage and absent in Stance by the driver's fixture that injects the missing consumer — a stronger check than either blind attempted.

skill2.driverSaid: no swap-level flag needed — the normal-fire path reads swap.trueNormals || hasTrueNormals, and trueNormalsModes sets the latter from the selected mode (engine fact verified by run, pinned G5)

skill2.explanation: Driver and blind converged on one carrier for both E1 and E2; G5's Stomp-specific assertions pin that the Stomp is true exactly in Engage.

skill2.driverSaid: fullCharge → enemy flatDamage 370.08 flavor 'true', mode Engage; crit omitted (engine default ON for skill hits), fires on the Stomp pull too (it is a full-charge attack)
skill2.blindSaid: S6 identical except explicit crit:true — behavior-identical since skill-damage crit defaults on (§2b); both S2b reviewers read the Stomp-pull inclusion the same literal way
skill2.formulaCheck: function-type skill damage: crits at caster rate, never cores, noRange forced, FB by landing time, no charge bucket — all engine defaults the driver leaves in place
skill2.explanation: G3 pins one rider per charged shot frame-locked, Stomp included, with the unswapped-only counterfactual dropping exactly the Stomp riders; G4 proves the true flavor is consumed by a True Damage ▲ buff and that it never cores. Stomp-pull inclusion is a literal-reading convention both blinds flagged ⚑ — a measurement recipe exists, not a gotcha.

skill2.blindSaid: S6 identical except explicit crit:true (same default-on equivalence); S5's linearity counterfactual (×0/×2) passes against this rider in the default Stance run

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs. All 13 kit lines are FAITHFUL (10) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (3: the mode toggle and the two ally-sync lines, each verbatim in unmodeled with caveats). Convergence is mechanical and GREEN: the S5 blind suite, traced against the driver's shipped override, passes every live assertion (the verbatim file's onEvent wiring sat at the CompOptions top level where runComp never reads it — a harness RECON error in the blind artifact, not a model divergence; with that one line routed through cfg, 11 pass / 3 skip, and my independent trace of each assertion against the shipped JSON agrees). The S6 blind override is block-equivalent to the driver's — every numeric field, trigger, gate, and duration encoding matches; the diffs are behavior-identical defaults (explicit crit:true vs the engine's default-on skill-hit crit, passive vs battleStart on a continuous buff, a non-binding swap durationSec that maxShots:1 always preempts). Discrimination holds: every load-bearing line has a named nearest-wrong counterfactual that fails in the driver's own suite (mode-blind, unswapped-only rider, de-flavored rider, no-trueNormalsModes, no-maxShots, faster clamp, 2-round 1400, all-allies 77.35), and the S5 suite independently re-derives the two headline traps (the 1400's round-vs-seconds semantics in both failure directions, the swap's 1-round budget). The same-model residual the owner should spot-check: every agent in this gauntlet read 'Duration: 1 rounds'/'for 1 rounds' as round counts and the mode machine as a static Stance-default selection — both well-argued from the prose but unanimously shared priors with no in-game measurement; plus the three ⚑ conventions carried honestly (S2 riders proc on the Stomp pull under the literal reading, the Stomp ammo economy, and Engage being credited from frame 0 with no ~1s toggle tax). Each has a recorded footage recipe; none is a number invented to hit a board.
